verdict.rationale: Bento documents a dashboard with built-in views of cost per run, tool failure rates, drift across prompt versions, and regressions across deploys. Releases are scored against production history, and the CLI can pull analytics. However, nothing shows users building custom dashboards or charting latency. Missing for 10: user-configurable custom dashboard builder, latency metrics, eval-score charting in dashboards, independent corroboration.
